briefdescription.para: Specialisation of DMat for ARingQQFlint matrices, backed by FLINT's fmpq_mat_t.

detaileddescription.para: Rational counterpart of DMat<ARingZZ>: wraps an fmpq_mat_t and forwards every dense matrix operation to FLINT's fmpq_mat_* routines. Same front-end caveat as the integer specialisation the fmpz_t parts of the rationals are outside the M2 GC's awareness, so instances of this class stay internal.
